name: @hyperbolic/broker-contract
description: The request/policy-document contract for the guards broker (Epic #182, issue #183): shape validation only, no runtime. Lives under packages/, not services/, because apps/toolbelt's manifest registry requires every services/* directory to carry a tool.json for a real deployable unit -- this package has no entry point yet. The broker's actual runtime service (services/broker/, with its own tool.json) imports this package once it exists.
